description: Returns the derivation ledger. With a symbol: the archived raw upstream payloads (SHA-256 pinned) and the collector code hash behind that network's recent fetches, so a published value can be re-derived independently. Without one: the symbols that have ledger entries. Read-only, no key. To compare a live value with its upstream right now, use verify_value.

symbol.description: Optional: filter to one symbol (e.g. AKT). Omit for the coverage list.

name: get_derivation_ledger
title: Get the derivation ledger
